name: Number of distinct eigenvalues of the Laplacian of the weighted n-cycle whose i-th edge has weight 1 or 2 according as the i-th term of the Fibonacci word A003849 is 0 or 1.
comment: The edge {i, i+1 mod n}, i = 1..n, has weight 1 if letter i of the Fibonacci word (fixed point of A->AB, B->A) is A and 2 if it is B. a(n) = n minus the sum over eigenvalues of (multiplicity - 1).

For n <= 400, a(n) < n only at n = 12, 20, 32, 33, 52, 53, 84, 106, 136, 220, 356, with deficits 3, 5, 8, 1, 13, 1, 21, 1, 34, 55, 89. Conjecture: a(4*F(k)) = 3*F(k) for k >= 4, where F = A000045, and otherwise a(n) = n except for a sparse set (33, 53, 106, ...) with deficit 1.
reference: M. Kohmoto, L. P. Kadanoff and C. Tang, Localization problem in one dimension: mapping and escape, Phys. Rev. Lett. 50 (1983), 1870-1872.
link: Scott M. Foltz, Table of n, a(n) for n = 3..400
example: a(12) = 9: the first 12 letters ABAABABAABAA give edge weights 1,2,1,1,2,1,2,1,1,2,1,1; the Laplacian has 3 double eigenvalues, so 12 - 3 = 9 distinct values.
program: a(n)={my(w=fibwts(n),M=matrix(n,n),j,wt,p); for(i=1,n, wt=w[i]; j=if(i<n,i+1,1); M[i,i]+=wt; M[j,j]+=wt; M[i,j]-=wt; M[j,i]-=wt); p=charpoly(M); poldegree(p)-poldegree(gcd(p,p'))};
